prompt:

Simple large clear shapes, controlled sparse brush marks, thin charcoal/brown linework; avoid dense texture or paper grain. No extra props, people, scenery, repeated objects or decorative clutter. Subject: THREE broad round lotus leaves at different low heights, one subtly cupped leaf, one OPEN soft ivory-pink lotus flower and one small closed bud on simple thin stems, all arranged as a compact single connected plant cluster. Leaves muted tea/sage green with a few understated radial veins, petals mostly ivory with faint dusty pink tips and small bamboo yellow center. Whole stems visible down to a shared low planting baseline; no exposed tangled roots. Elevated three-quarter game view, low leaves foreshortened cleanly at approx2:1 horizontal ellipse, no dramatic perspective.
Square target1024×1024, plant cluster centered occupying at most75% canvas width/height. Leaf edges, petals, stems fully intact, generous transparent padding.
